items.title: How Cyberattacks Affect Individuals and Organizations (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of How Cyberattacks Affect Individuals and Organizations (PDF 126, printed 122).

blocks.text: Cyberattacks afraad (individuals) aur idaron (organizations) dono ko sakht nuqsan pohancha sakte hain. Log apni zaati files, passwords ya paisa kho sakte hain, jab ke companies ko data breach aur customers ka bharosa khone ka saamna ho sakta hai. Hamle karobar ka kaam rok sakte hain, saakh (reputation) kharab kar sakte hain aur maali nuqsan ka sabab ban sakte hain. Schools aur hospitals bhi cyber waqiaat se mutasir ho sakte hain.

blocks.caption: Hamle ka asar
rows: Zaati files, passwords ya paise ka nuqsan
Data breach aur gahakon ka bharosa khatam
Karobar ruk jana, sakh (reputation) kharab, maali nuqsan

blocks.prompt: Cyberattack aik company ko kin teen tareeqon se nuqsan deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Data breach aur gahakon ka bharosa khatam hona, karobar ke kaam ruk jana, sakh (reputation) kharab hona aur maali nuqsan (koi teen).

items: Afraad: files, passwords, paisa; idare: data breach, bharosa, reputation, maali nuqsan.
Schools aur hospitals bhi mutasir ho sakte hain.
